subject: Redwood Inference — procurement path & marketplace interest (LumenAI)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@lumenai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference — procurement path & marketplace interest (LumenAI)

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call today, great to meet you and hear more about LumenAI's evaluation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on procurement readiness and the commercial path.

Recap (high level):
- Eval focus: low-latency text generation for inference-heavy workflows, predictable cost, and audit logging.
- Technical follow-ups: Dev asked for token-cost projection for 25k qps spikes and details on KV caching.
- Procurement signal: you mentioned procurement prefers marketplace purchases (AWS Marketplace) but central procurement can also do PO-based contracts for important vendors.

Proposed commercial paths (please confirm which is easiest for you):
1) AWS Marketplace subscription (preferred by your PM): faster onboarding for SSO/billing, Redwood provides marketplace listing + metered billing SKU.
2) Direct PO/invoice (standard SOW + net-30 invoice) — we can support signing via DocuSign and your centralized PO process.
3) Hybrid: short pilot on card to validate, then move to PO or marketplace for production.

Items we need from you to qualify procurement readiness:
- Which path do you prefer (Marketplace vs PO vs card)?
- If PO: target billing entity, required contract terms (if any), and PO template.
- If Marketplace: confirm AWS account/owner and whether you need a private offer.
- Any mandatory legal clauses or security attachments (SOC2, DPA) we should surface now.

I've attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines and responsibilities — see attachment: 20260212-lumenai-map.pdf.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred commercial path and procurement contact (if different from Sofia).
- Dev and I will prepare SKU/pricing and a short marketplace onboarding checklist if Marketplace is preferred.
- If PO path, we can loop in RevOps to speed contract intake.

Thanks — happy to sync live if it helps get procurement unblocked.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: 20260212-lumenai-map.pdf (mutual action plan, 2 pages)

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@lumenai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — procurement path & marketplace interest (LumenAI)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Helpful. Quick answers below: 

- Preferred path: our procurement team prefers AWS Marketplace for vendor management reasons, but they can accept a direct PO for strategic vendors. For speed, Marketplace is best.
- Procurement contact: procurement@lumenai.com (cc'ing them would be fine).
- AWS details: we use the org billing account under aws-account-admin@lumenai.com and would likely want a private offer if we move to an annual commitment.
- Required docs: procurement asked for an invoice sample, Redwood's W-9, and confirmation of SOC 2 Type II (we saw the summary you linked on the call).

Would you be able to share the marketplace SKU and a short checklist of steps we need to complete on our side? If doable, we can run this through procurement next week.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Platform Partnerships | LumenAI
sofia.ramirez@lumenai.com

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — procurement path & marketplace interest (LumenAI)

Thanks Sofia — looping procurement as you suggested. Dev and I put together the two quick commercial paths with what we need from you so procurement can move fast. See below and let us know which you prefer.

Option A — AWS Marketplace (recommended for fastest procurement):
- Redwood provides a metered SKU and, if requested, a Private Offer with annual commitment pricing.
- What we need from LumenAI: AWS billing account ID, contact for private-offer negotiation, and procurement approval (PO not required for marketplace purchases).
- Timeline: marketplace listing usage can start within ~5 business days after labeling and private offer setup.

Option B — Direct PO/invoice (if procurement requires vendor contract):
- We provide SOW or MSA + W-9, sign via DocuSign, Redwood issues invoice on net-30 or negotiated terms.
- What we need from LumenAI: PO template, billing entity name, and any required legal addenda.
- Timeline: typically 7–14 business days for standard PO intake (can be faster if procurement provides template).

Attached: quick SKU/pricing snapshot and a one-page marketplace onboarding checklist. I can share the SKU privately if you prefer; otherwise below is a demo link to the marketplace listing we usually mirror: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-EXAMPLE-SKU

If procurement prefers Marketplace, I can introduce our Marketplace Ops contact and kick off the private-offer process.

Best,
Marissa

From: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — procurement path & marketplace interest (LumenAI)

Hi Marissa — procurement here. Confirming a few items so we can triage internally: 

1) Marketplace vs PO: Our preference is AWS Marketplace for SaaS vendors because it simplifies vendor onboarding. We are open to a Private Offer if Redwood can provide standard enterprise pricing and a SKU.

2) Docs required: sample invoice, Redwood W-9, SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF), and a short data processing addendum (DPA) or pointer to your standard DPA.

3) Approval steps:
- We run a quick vendor risk review (~3 business days) once files are submitted.
- Procurement approval and finance sign-off (~5 business days) after vendor review.

4) Questions: do you support invoice billing under a Redwood trading entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and can you provide a draft private-offer SKUs/pricing that we can evaluate?

Please send the requested docs and the SKU/pricing snapshot to procurement@lumenai.com and we will take it from there.

Thanks,
LumenAI Procurement
procurement@lumenai.com
